purpose: Choose one value from a labelled mutually exclusive set with native form integration.
avoid: Independent yes/no choices require different semantics.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: The family presents controls or navigation; static depictions do not establish an interactive contract.
sourceRule: RadioGroup uses a generic value/defaultValue and onValueChange(value,eventDetails), plus disabled/readOnly/required/name/form. RadioGroupItem inherits the exact Radio.Root props including value and disabled. The default visible root is span role=radio with a hidden native radio input, not a visible native radio. Checked value is singular; choosing the checked item does not clear the group. Disabled/readOnly suppress user changes; callback cancellation can veto and controlled props stay authoritative.
keyboardAndFocus: Tab enters the current/enabled radio; arrows navigate/select enabled items using the source composite and wrap behavior. Space selects a radio. Enter does not toggle (the source prevents its button activation; form context remains separate). Home/End are disabled by the RadioGroup composite; Escape does not clear selection.
referenceDecision: Named mutually exclusive delivery options retain native hidden form values. Concrete group help/error and readonly/disabled examples are caller composition; actual DirectionProvider enables RTL composite navigation.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: Actual visible 16px source radios contain the checked-only 8px primary-foreground dot and the real hidden native form input. No duplicate synthetic native control or decorative classification is introduced. Native control/label gap 8px is retained;12px option spacing is an explicit caller layout decision because Root supplies no option layout. The selected background/border follows native primary roles; invalid styling changes border while readable group help/error describes the issue. Checked value stays singular, native form name/value remains plan, and labels explicitly name the actual visible roles. Disabled fades the control; readOnly stays focusable and visually distinct from disabled. Arrow/Space selection, Enter nonactivation, Home/End nonhandling and controlled cancellation follow actual source composite behavior. RTL keyboard composition requires the real DirectionProvider plus HTML direction.
